decision.observation: Hornet stands on a black mushroom cap right of the ornate snail-wheel, which clearly has a snail head and eyestalk at its upper-right. The stone-tiled path runs left beneath the wheel, and leafy plants line the mossy ground.
decision.hypothesis: This snail-shell may be a rest bench like earlier wheels, triggered by walking into its base from the ground. Dropping left to the stone path and approaching the wheel's left base will test it.
decision.memory: Snail wheels: hub and East Grotto wheels appeared to trigger crouch-rest on contact; this western one untested from the ground-left base.
